description: Public creator surface from Lex Fridman Podcast #442 (YouTube qCbfTN-caFI). Every claim cites video + timestamp.

atoms.text: A good conversation requires duration; longer form relaxes people and lets the complexity of a person show in the details.

provenance.source_excerpt: I do think a good conversation requires that kind of duration. ... I think the longer form with a hypothetical skilled conversationalist relaxes things and allows people to go on tangents and to banter about the details because I think it's in the details that the beautiful complexity of the person is brought to light.

atoms.text: Each conversation is its own unique puzzle; there is no general formula for how to approach one.

provenance.source_excerpt: Now each conversation is its own unique puzzle. So I can't speak generally to how I approach these.

atoms.text: Convincing world leaders and their teams to talk for two to five hours is hard, and a good conversation requires that kind of duration.

provenance.source_excerpt: So to convince them and their team to talk for two, three, four, five hours is hard. And I do think a good conversation requires that kind of duration.
